names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 22 decembrie, «Sfântul Ierarh Petru Movilă, Mitropolitul Kievului», with the rank and the see left off.

Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Святитель Петр (Могила), митрополит киевский»: «Святитель», «митрополит» and the see are rank words and are stripped, the surname kept — and the surname is what makes this form storable at all, the bare «Петр» being a fold eleven corpus folders already share. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; the folder had no Cyrillic form of any kind.

office: Metropolitan of Kiev, Galicia and all Rus'

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «s-a născut la Suceava, la 21 Decembrie 1596».

death.note: doxologia.ro: «A trecut la Domnul în ziua de 22 Decembrie 1646, fiind îngropat în biserica mare a Mănăstirii Pecerska».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 декабря ст. ст. — «Свт. Петра Могилы, митрополита Киевского (1646).»

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry. The folder’s only other venerated row is Romanian and keeps him on 22 December in the revised Julian calendar — ANOTHER CHURCH’S DAY, not a second Russian one, and it was not touched; the schema holds one row per church and this calendar’s is 31 December. The line says «митрополита Киевского» and the name page «митрополит киевский», in lower case, which are the `metropolitan` and `hierarch` the folder’s `types` already carry and the see its `office` already names in full. THE LINE CLOSES «(1646)», which is the year the folder already reads for Petru Movilă. NO `dates` WERE WRITTEN. No life page stands behind this entry on this calendar, and the folder’s life is already written. The day page prints one hymn only, a kontakion of the venerable Melania, and nothing under this name.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 22 decembrie — «Sfântul Ierarh Petru Movilă, Mitropolitul Kievului»
